resolved_contract_gaps.title: RG-06 staged-payment operation registry
resolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: The v2 action registry has no closed actions or strict inputs for group creation, stage payment, fulfillment, completion, source intake, candidate confirmation, evidence linking, mirror merge, rejection, or retry.
resolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register closed action_type/operation_class pairs with strict accepted/no-change input and sparse rejected attempted_input, deterministic IDs, exhaustive deltas, exact returned IDs, and explicit confirmation.
resolved_contract_gaps.risk: Without closed actions an adapter could guess payment role or binding, merge payment and fulfillment, or duplicate effects on retry.
resolved_contract_gaps.implemented_change: Implemented the closed RG-06 operation registry, strict accepted/no-change inputs, sparse rejected attempted inputs, exhaustive deltas, returned identities, retry identity, and fixture-derived rejection dispatch.
alternatives: Keep the pre-closure contract and leave RG-06 expected output blocked.

resolved_contract_gaps.title: Staged-payment source and candidate payloads
resolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: Current source/candidate unions cannot preserve staged bank-payment facts, immutable source time, confidence, explicit null role ambiguity, exact binding provenance, or candidate history.
resolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register closed staged-payment source and candidate subtypes with source/evidence references, amount, currency, source_payment_at, role facts, confidence, rule version, confirmation requirements, and exact binding.
resolved_contract_gaps.risk: Dropping these facts would permit auto-confirmation or role guessing and sever provenance from formal payments.
resolved_contract_gaps.implemented_change: Implemented closed staged-payment source and candidate ownership, immutable provenance, explicit role ambiguity, confirmation history, confirmation operations, and manual save confirmation ownership.
alternatives: Keep the pre-closure contract and leave RG-06 expected output blocked.

resolved_contract_gaps.title: staged_payment relation, lifecycle entity, and installment payments
resolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: staged_payment and installment_payment are reserved but lack closed contracts. Current v2 cannot express an identity-only staged_payment relation, the separate staged-payment lifecycle domain payload, two stable installment-payment identities, or their exact formal transaction and posting bindings.
resolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register a staged_payment relation containing only stable id, type, and typed member_refs; register a separate staged-payment lifecycle domain entity payload for total, paid, due, category, labels, independent statuses, and ordered immutable state_history; register installment_payment entities binding each role, amount, currency, account, transaction, expense posting, asset posting, actual/statistics time, and optional source time. group.id maps only to relation.id and group.type alone maps to relation.type.
resolved_contract_gaps.risk: Putting amounts or lifecycle state on the relation would blur identity linkage with business ownership; conflating group.id and group.type or collapsing the two installment identities could duplicate or prematurely recognize accounting effects.
resolved_contract_gaps.implemented_change: Implemented identity-only staged_payment relations, separate lifecycle and installment entities, relation member topology, exact formal transaction/posting bindings, and balanced lifecycle history.
alternatives: Keep the pre-closure contract and leave RG-06 expected output blocked.

resolved_contract_gaps.title: Independent staged-payment status registries
resolved_contract_gaps.capability_boundary: The derived-status and lifecycle registries lack independent payment_progress, fulfillment_status, staged-payment reconciliation, and a closed ordered immutable state_history payload owned by the staged-payment domain entity.
resolved_contract_gaps.required_change: Register payment_progress and fulfillment_status as separate current domain-entity statuses, staged-payment reconciliation as an independent domain-entity projection, and payload.state_history[*] with exact id, event, occurred_at, total_amount, paid_amount, due_amount, payment_id, payment_progress, fulfillment_status, and state_transition_effect_count fields. Never flatten history fields into current status or relation payload.
resolved_contract_gaps.risk: Flattening history or attaching status to the relation could erase lifecycle evidence, mark unpaid amounts paid, or duplicate consumption when fulfillment/completion changes.
resolved_contract_gaps.implemented_change: Implemented independent derived statuses, ordered lifecycle history, zero-effect fulfillment/completion transitions, and no-change retry preservation.
alternatives: Keep the pre-closure contract and leave RG-06 expected output blocked.

resolved_contract_gaps.title: Bank payment evidence and mirror lineage
